subject: ISV demo entitlement & cobranded marketplace listing — VectorLabs onboarding
messages:
From: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@vectorlabs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@vectorlabs.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ISV demo entitlement + cobranded listing questions

Hi Mateo / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our product & partnerships team reviewed the Redwood listing flow and we have a couple of operational asks before we publish the listing and enable co-sell: 

1) Demo tenant provisioning — can you confirm whether Redwood can create short-lived demo accounts with a 14-day trial token tied to our marketplace SKUs? We need a predictable way to route paid-conversion telemetry back to our billing SKU for reporting.

2) Cobranded listing assets — we plan to use a VectorLabs logo variant on the Redwood marketplace tile. Any constraints on image dimensions/clearance?

3) Security evidence — our compliance folks asked for a minimal evidence binder for marketplace approval (SOC 2 attestation date, data residency, audit log access). Do you have a template?

I've attached a quick CSV with the initial set of demo credentials we usually provision for pilots. Attaching a draft of the listing copy as well. Can we sync on Friday to confirm next steps?

Attachments: vector-demo-credentials.csv, VectorLabs-Marketplace-Listing-Draft.pdf

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Gomez
Head of Partnerships, VectorLabs
partners@vectorlabs.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@vectorlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISV demo entitlement + cobranded listing questions

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front: yes on demo tenants, yes on cobranded assets (we have a small QA gating step), and yes on a minimal security evidence checklist (we keep a one-page template for listing intake). Details below and a few action items so we don't block the launch: 

- Demo tenant provisioning: We can provision time-limited demo tokens scoped to VectorLabs SKUs. Operational details: tokens expire by default in 14 days; we can emit a webhook to your billing endpoint with the conversion event. Two items we need from you: (a) preferred callback URL for conversion events, (b) the SKU mapping (marketplace SKU -> VectorLabs internal SKU).

- Cobranded assets: PNG at 1200x675 px works best for the tile; we also need a 1:1 square (800x800) for catalog thumbnails. No animated GIFs; transparent backgrounds ok. We will run a quick brand-compliance pass (legal + marketing) before publish — this usually takes <48 hours.

- Security evidence: Olga, can you attach the lightweight evidence checklist we use for marketplace listings?

Action items (proposed):
  1) Sarah: send callback URL and SKU mapping (CSV).
  2) VectorLabs: update the attached listing PDF with the final tile copy.
  3) Olga: confirm evidence checklist and any additional gating that would block publish.

If those look good, Ben and I can schedule a 30-min ops walkthrough on Friday 09/24 at 10:00 PT.

Best,
Mateo
Sr. Partnerships Manager 
Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick compliance notes from my side: 

- Evidence checklist: attached (security-evidence-quicklist.xlsx). It includes the minimum items we require for a public listing: SOC 2 date, data residency region (US/EU/APAC), encryption at rest key type, and access to audit logs for 90 days. If VectorLabs cannot provide some items, we can proceed with a private listing or a "limited visibility" publish while those items are collected.

- Demo tenant telemetry: We need the webhook callback to be on HTTPS with a valid cert and basic auth token. We will not send PII in the conversion webhook — only an event id + SKU. Please confirm design on your side.

- Legal: regarding cobranded assets, have VectorLabs sign the co-marketing agreement (one-pager) that Ben will send. That covers logo usage and attribution in the listing.

I'm attaching the evidence quicklist and adding estimated gating: if VectorLabs provides SOC 2 date + residency + webhook URL this week, we can get the listing into the staging catalog by 09/28 and live by ~10/05.

Attachments: security-evidence-quicklist.xlsx

Regards,
Olga
Marketplace & Partner Compliance
Redwood Inference
